{{Quote|We must keep our position secret. Send out the hunters. I want all of those lifepods destroyed.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="RM" />}}
The '''''Droch''-class boarding ship''', also known as the '''pod hunter''' and the '''Separatist boarding craft''' and nicknamed "'''juicers'''" by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], was a model of [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and built by the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:DrochclassBoardingShip-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Starboard profile with pincers closed.]]

The [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] makers of the ''Droch''-class based its design on the [[Toothspike raptor/Legends|toothspike raptor]] of [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]].<ref name="TCW:TVG" />

The ''Droch''-class was armed with a large set of four spikes arranged around the cockpit, that were used to crush an object trapped inside the array,<ref name="RM" /> which led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to name the ships "juicers."<ref name="RM Decoded">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''|d=y}}</ref> These four spikes also could be used to pierce the hull of a [[Capital ship/Legends|ship]] and deploy a boarding party.<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> It usually carried a few [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]]. The pilot sat on top of the vehicle, and it could be used as a local transport for several troops, which entered and exited from a central passenger compartment.<ref name="RM" /> The boarding craft was lightly armed, with a number of light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

The versatile troop transport could be used to capture enemy starships relatively intact, to be later used in covert missions.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
{{Quote|What the&mdash;?|[[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]] after spotting a Droch-class boarding ship|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sepboardcra.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''Droch''-class ship used to crush life pods after the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]].]]

Pod hunters were used at the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]], where they hunted down [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] from [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']], crushing them and killing their passengers. There, the pod hunter transported rocket battle droids. However the pod hunter and the droids were destroyed in an encounter with Jedi Master Plo Koon and several clone troopers. One of these pods was [[Pod 1977/Legends|Pod 1977]].<ref name="RM" />

Not long after, a squad of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] used one to land on the [[Rishi moon]] under the cover of a meteor shower, [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacking]] the Republic [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] there in preparation to invade [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Rookies" /> Later, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a squad of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] used three ships to board the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], carrying [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and their captive [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], in an attempt to [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|free]] the captive Gunray.<ref name="COD" />

Later in the war, the pod hunters [[Battle of Juma 9|boarded]] [[Juma 9]] in aiding [[Kul Teska]]. Despite their deliveries of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]], B2 super battle droids and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], they were unable to secure the station when reinforcements under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrived.

Additionally, three boarded the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] vessel [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], deploying super battle droids to aid [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] in transporting the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] off ship. The droids were destroyed by the clone troopers and the [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]], however, and Merrik was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
